When a Recording Song is loaded, its fixed note/control/tempo timeline is authoritative. Key/mode/rhythm/tempo fields read Recorded during exact playback; EDIT develops its separate starting progression as a new draft.

Coral Bloom, Aurora and Studio Rack are historical explorations, not selected. The owner-provided fm1_adaptive_motion_prototype.html is the authoritative visual/motion base; the static nine-screen image remains a layout reference.
Motion has exactly On / Off. On adapts to smoothed volume/output level and active instrument count. No separate Quiet/Expressive/Reduced/Calm, Intensity or Speed motion preference.

Use the prototype’s large chord hero, flat aligned type, thin separators, paired degree/name cue and four text control columns with bank name/count/dots. Instrument Teal is default; Studio and Editorial are palettes of the same layout.
Use resolved playing/ownership and the shared clock. A smoothed output/active-part snapshot requires implementation; prototype-supplied levels are simulations, not hardware FFT/velocity measurements.

Off stops every animation/transition, including CSS pulses/halos, Morph/Bloom and parameter/bank/focus/save fades. Chord/notes/degree/cursor/status still update instantly; OS reduced motion may force effective Off privately.
Measure and cap foreground cadence, dirty regions, pixel work and scratch memory under demanding audio/USB. Do not promise FPS, CPU savings or polyphony from a concept.

The F-major seventh-color demonstration is explicitly arranged IVmaj7 → V7 → vi7 → Imaj7: Bbmaj7 → C7 → Dm7 → Fmaj7, with C7 notes C E G Bb. This stored V7 does not change deliberate live 7 following major/minor quality, including Emaj7 → Bmaj7 → D♯m7.
Instrument Teal palette: bg #061b1e, fg #f2f8f4, muted #89a7a5, line #355054, subtle #113034, accent #77dacb, onAccent #092d2c; custom solid accents must preserve contrast.

Retain all nine prototype studies, including Chord Morph and Generative / Bloom. Unsupported morph/generative DSP, Grain/Shimmer/Freeze/Human and all pictured capabilities are not thereby implemented.
CORE is Rhythm / Key / Scale / Tempo. PRESETS stays global chord sound, HOME SELECT stays the complete catalogue, and OCT−/OCT+ stay musical.
HOME tap cycling reuses the existing view gesture and needs physical verification. No hold chord or encoder push. A bank switch changes no sound, value, note ownership, recording source or transport.

The latest adaptive-motion prototype is preserved byte-for-byte as the visual reference. Its up-to-eight demo layers are simulated response inputs, not a promise of eight device parts/engines/tracks/voices.

states: Implemented in development source on top of 4502c2f; native host captures and linked firmware, physical review pending.
Fill begins at the next bar, lasts exactly one current-metre bar, then resumes the original phrase position automatically. First half retains the groove, second half turns around.
Lo-fi uses the current swing plus snare/tom movement; Trap/CloudTrap/Plugg/Rage/Drill/Grime use tighter snare/hat rolls. Sequencer copies select the family by kit.

Drop gates drums at the next bar, fading existing dry drum voices over one control block; effect tails decay naturally. Chords/bass/live HOLD continue. Back restores the groove phase on the next downbeat.
One pending moment; latest action wins. Repeated active Fill never extends it; Fill while dropped is unavailable. Back can replace a pending Drop.
Playback/compatible groove required. Clock waiting/lost/paused and count-in/recording disable actions. Stop, panic, recording ownership and clock interruption clear transient moments.
Fills/drops are live only in v1 and are not written into saved patterns or takes. Existing manual REC remains unchanged; use USB/external audio capture for these moments.

Motion On uses the real output activity plus bar phase: fill tension, smaller drop pulse, finite outward downbeat bloom. Motion Off cancels effects immediately while status stays truthful. No missed bloom replays after navigation or Off.
Build is the rising fill tension in v1; a separate multi-bar build and Breakdown to chords alone remain later work.

workflows.goal: Hear a musical song immediately.

steps.action: Turn SELECT through the complete wrapping list.

steps.action: Turn K1 to a compatible groove or Off.
steps.result: Tempo remains yours.

steps.action: Press PLAY.
steps.result: Slot 1 and groove downbeat start together; large chord, degree and ordered rail agree.

steps.action: Press PLAY again.
steps.result: Accompaniment stops; independent live HOLD remains.

workflows.goal: Change rhythm, key, mode and tempo from HOME.

steps.action: Turn K1 during playback.
steps.result: New groove appears as pending and begins next bar.

steps.action: Turn K2 or K3.
steps.result: Latest complete key/mode request applies at next chord onset; active labels stay truthful.

steps.action: Turn K4.
steps.result: Internal tempo changes promptly without resetting slot, bar or drum phase.

steps.action: Turn SELECT to another song.
steps.result: Next shows its seed setup; the whole new song begins at the next bar. Browse back to active to cancel.

workflows.goal: Use live roots/HOLD without fighting scheduled chord ownership.

steps.action: While the loop runs, press a root; use upper modifiers deliberately.
steps.result: Live chord and linked bass temporarily take harmony ownership; drums and actual scheduled cursor continue.

steps.action: Use HOLD, or release the roots.
steps.result: HOLD sustains live takeover. After its final live root/latch releases, the currently scheduled chord resumes for the remaining slot time.

steps.action: Press PLAY to stop.
steps.result: Only accompaniment ownership stops; a live held chord survives.

steps.result: Mode changes on the documented bar boundary.

steps.action: Choose Groove tab and select the pattern.
steps.result: Kit/swing defaults apply without replacing user tempo.

steps.action: Press HOME, then PLAY and play roots.
steps.result: One groove clock supports immediate manual chord performance.

steps.result: Only this planned chord changes; global Harmony/modifiers stay intact.

steps.result: Units and articulation are explicit.

steps.result: The resolved notes show the actual planned voicing.

steps.action: Press SEL to audition, or PLAY to hear the phrase.
steps.result: Intentional audition/plan playback respects live ownership and safe plan boundaries.

steps.result: Songs opens with the new recording selected; no hidden recordings list or required Keep.

workflows.title: Capture a running performance
workflows.goal: Arm at the next bar without restarting the existing phrase.

steps.action: During playback, press REC.
steps.result: HOME shows Armed; the current progression/groove keep playing.

steps.action: Reach the next downbeat.
steps.result: Capture begins from the actual phrase position and currently audible state.

steps.action: Press PLAY for a short end.
steps.result: Close at actual elapsed time, stop accompaniment promptly, and auto-create a new Song copy without padded silence.

steps.action: Press SAVE after completion.
steps.result: See duration, Recording type and true Pending/Saving/Saved status in Songs.

workflows.title: Record your own chords over drums
workflows.goal: Use the same capture method with an intentional accompaniment choice.

steps.action: Press SEQ, choose Loop and set Drums only.
steps.result: Automatic chords are off by your explicit choice, not by REC.

steps.action: Press HOME and REC.
steps.result: Normal stopped count-in or running next-bar arm begins.

steps.action: Play roots/modifiers over the groove; finish with REC or PLAY.
steps.result: A new Recording Song captures the heard manual performance and accompaniment.

workflows.title: Finish saving a Pending capture
workflows.goal: Keep captured content visible if sound/storage/capacity prevents persistence.

steps.action: Read Pending and its reason after the recording ends.
steps.result: No false Saved label; the protected capture is in Songs.

steps.action: Press SAVE to open the selected Pending row.
steps.result: Type and duration remain visible alongside saved Songs.

steps.action: Press EDIT to Manage; remove chosen Saved content if storage is full.
steps.result: Pending and protected current/draft content are excluded from bulk clear.

steps.action: Stop accompaniment and release live-held notes when the prompt asks.
steps.result: Existing quiet/storage guards permit the automatic safe write; audible tails are not cut.

steps.action: Wait for validation.
steps.result: Pending becomes Saved; another REC may create the next new copy.

workflows.title: Save an editable progression Song
workflows.goal: Keep current-save distinct from highlighted-row management.

steps.action: Press SAVE from HOME to open Songs, then SAVE to save current.
steps.result: A new progression opens a prefilled name; the highlighted row is not an overwrite target.

steps.action: Keep the suggested name or edit it; press SAVE.
steps.result: A new Progression Song saves directly when safe, with no extra free-slot review.

steps.action: For an edited saved current, choose Save As New or explicit Update.
steps.result: Original remains unchanged unless named Update is confirmed.

steps.action: If Update was chosen, check the target/count and press SAVE on Update.
steps.result: Only the named existing Song is updated.

workflows.title: Find and load either Song type
workflows.goal: Make row browsing safe and playback source explicit.

steps.action: Press SAVE; SELECT highlights a row.
steps.result: Rows show Progression/Recording type, duration and status; highlighting alone changes no music.

steps.action: Press SEL on the intended row.
steps.result: Load applies stopped or queues the complete Saved setup at next bar.

steps.action: Press HOME and PLAY.
steps.result: Progression plays semantic chords; Recording plays its fixed note/control/tempo timeline.

steps.action: For a Recording, Manage → Details → EDIT develops its start.
steps.result: A new semantic Progression draft is editable without rewriting the recorded performance.

workflows.title: Rename, duplicate or delete one Song
workflows.goal: Manage the highlighted row with direct physical controls.

steps.action: SELECT the row and press EDIT.
steps.result: Manage keeps the selected Song name/type visible.

steps.action: Choose Rename, Duplicate or Delete, then SAVE/SEL.
steps.result: Rename uses text entry; Duplicate creates a new numbered ID; Delete opens one named counted confirmation.

steps.action: Choose Delete and press SAVE; HOME cancels.
steps.result: Only one Saved row is removed once safe; loaded audio, protected draft and Pending remain.

steps.action: Return to Songs.
steps.result: The exact result is visible; there is no deep take browser.

workflows.title: Record → Songs → delete or clear recordings
workflows.goal: Make capture and cleanup one obvious route.

steps.action: REC finishes at next bar, or PLAY ends now.
steps.result: Accompaniment stops; a new Recording Song auto-saves when safe.

steps.action: Press SAVE to see it; SELECT the desired row, then EDIT.
steps.result: Manage acts on the visible highlighted Song.

steps.action: For one item choose Delete, then confirm count 1 with SAVE.
steps.result: Only that Saved Song is deleted.

steps.action: For a batch choose Clear Recordings in Manage; read the saved count and confirm with SAVE.
steps.result: One explicit confirmation clears Saved Recording rows only; Pending/draft/current audible copy remain.

steps.action: Clear All Songs is the separate all-types option with its own visible count.
steps.result: HOME cancels either counted confirmation; no silent library-wide deletion.

workflows.title: Return to a draft, undo or recover
workflows.goal: Keep protected musical edits outside library clear scope.

steps.action: Open Songs and press EDIT for Manage.
steps.result: Return to Draft and Undo remain visible even if the Saved list is empty.

steps.action: Choose Return to Draft and execute Return.
steps.result: Draft becomes current/queued without an Apply step on normal factory browsing.

steps.action: Manage → Undo restores one musical gesture.
steps.result: Saved-row deletion is not disguised as musical undo.

steps.action: After restart Recover the last valid stopped checkpoint.
steps.result: Opens stopped; a never-written Pending recording is not falsely claimed recoverable.

workflows.title: Use the six HOME pages
workflows.goal: Reach existing controls without sacrificing CORE, full catalogue browsing or musical keys.

steps.action: Press HOME from another workspace
steps.result: Progressions opens CORE: Rhythm / Key / Scale / Tempo

steps.action: Tap HOME while already on Progressions
steps.result: SOUND: Chord sound / Bass sound / Chord level / Bass level; bank selection changes no values

steps.action: Tap HOME again
steps.result: TEXTURE: Reverb mix / Delay mix / Chorus mix / Glide

steps.action: Tap HOME again
steps.result: GROOVE: Kit / Drum level / Swing / Click

steps.action: Tap HOME again
steps.result: PERFORM: Fill / Drop / Back / Tempo. Turning K1–K3 triggers a bar-queued moment; bank selection alone changes no music.

steps.action: Tap HOME after Perform
steps.result: KEYBOARD 6/6 uses the full screen for current key assignments and explanations. All four knobs are inactive.

steps.action: Tap HOME again
steps.result: CORE returns. SELECT still browses all songs; PRESETS stays chord sound; OCT keys remain musical.

workflows.title: Browse, audition and replace a chord
workflows.goal: Choose a named chord from the reference without losing the numbered edit destination or altering global Harmony.

steps.action: Open EDIT and SELECT the destination slot
steps.result: A numbered draft slot is focused; the source Song remains untouched.

steps.action: Turn ALGORITHM to Library and SELECT a candidate
steps.result: The reference list browses silently; target slot, degree, notes and variant are visible.

steps.action: Press SEL
steps.result: A deliberate bounded audition uses the shared note-owner rules; the slot is unchanged.

steps.action: Press EDIT Replace
steps.result: The named slot receives the candidate, one-step undo is available and any running plan change follows its musical boundary.

workflows.title: Perform fills, drops and downbeat returns
workflows.goal: Add live dramatic moments from HOME; Breakdown is deferred.

steps.action: Start a groove; tap HOME to Perform
steps.result: Four labelled controls stay below the actual chord and phrase.

steps.action: Turn K1 once
steps.result: FILL NEXT becomes a one-bar Fill at the next bar; the groove returns automatically with a bloom.

steps.action: Turn K2, keep playing, then turn K3 when ready
steps.result: Drums leave next bar; chords and bass continue. BACK NEXT restores drums on the next downbeat.

steps.action: Set Motion Off in Display
steps.result: The same musical actions work; labels update with no fill animation or bloom.

workflows.title: Learn the physical keys while playing
workflows.goal: Understand notes, chord choices and HOLD without leaving HOME or interrupting normal playing.

steps.action: Tap HOME until Keyboard 6/6
steps.result: All 27 physical keys are labelled; root notes and degrees follow the active key, scale and octave.

steps.action: Press an upper chord key, then a lower root key
steps.result: Normal live playing continues; the last key has its full name and plain-language explanation.

steps.action: Turn any of K1–K4
steps.result: Nothing changes. The knob area belongs to the key guide on this page.

steps.action: Tap HOME once more
steps.result: Core returns with its normal four musical knobs. Notes, groove and transport retain their owners.
